title: Testing REST Controllers with @WebMvcTest
description: Slice test your web layer using MockMvc to simulate HTTP requests.

slides.title: Slice Testing the Web Layer 🌐
slides.content:
# @WebMvcTest

This annotation loads only the web layer (controllers, filters, etc.) – not full application context. It auto‑configures **MockMvc** to simulate HTTP requests without starting a real server.

You'll typically mock the service layer dependencies.

quizData.question: Which annotation is used to test a Spring MVC controller slice?
quizData.explanation: @WebMvcTest focuses on controllers and related components, providing MockMvc for testing.
